project_info.theme: avant-garde Nike sports fashion advertisement with monumental basketball sculpture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 1:1 avant-garde Nike sports-fashion advertisement in a burnt-orange studio. Feature a confident adult female athlete with a curvy feminine silhouette, natural skin texture, long braided hair, and focused expression. She wears a fitted beige Nike performance crop top, matching fitted athletic shorts, long Nike socks, and cream Nike sneakers with visible swoosh details. Recline her across the curved surface of an oversized basketball like sculptural furniture, torso supported by one arm, the other hand resting on the ball, legs bent in a dynamic athletic line. Use giant cream ELEVATE typography behind her, a glossy reflective floor, and small legible text RISE ABOVE. OWN EVERY MOMENT.
